### ShareGPT
#### Insights
- **Output throughput:** vLLM gives the strongest throughput curve overall, scaling from 6.9K tok/s at concurrency 60 to 23.5K tok/s in the no-cap run. SGLang remains competitive through most capped runs, while TensorRT-LLM stays lower than vLLM across the sweep.

## Qwen3-32B
### ShareGPT
#### Insights
- **Output throughput:** vLLM reaches the highest throughput in several capped runs and peaks above 4.2K tok/s at concurrency 600. SGLang becomes close to vLLM at higher concurrency. TensorRT-LLM is stable but lower, staying around 3.2K tok/s after concurrency 240.

web.description:
We ran all three on the same H100 80GB with Llama 3.3 70B Instruct at FP8 precision. A newer entrant, [TokenSpeed](https://www.spheron.network/blog/deploy-tokenspeed-gpu-cloud/), benchmarks a 9% latency and 11% throughput edge over TensorRT-LLM on B200 for agentic coding workloads and is worth adding to your own bake-off.

## Benchmark Results
### Throughput (Output Tokens per Second)
SGLang falls between vLLM and TensorRT-LLM at high concurrency.

### Peak VRAM Usage
| Engine | Idle (model loaded) | Peak at 50 req | Peak at 100 req |
|-|-|-|-|
| TensorRT-LLM | 74 GB | 77 GB | 79 GB |
| SGLang | 72 GB | 75 GB | 78 GB |

### Cold Start Time
| Engine | Time to First Request |
|-|-|
| vLLM | ~62 seconds |
| TensorRT-LLM | ~28 minutes (engine compilation) |
| SGLang | ~58 seconds |

web.description:
# Achieving Faster Open-Source Llama3 Serving with SGLang Runtime (vs. TensorRT-LLM, vLLM)
## Llama-8B on 1 x A100 (bf16)
Both TensorRT-LLM and SGLang can achieve an excellent throughput of up to 5000 tokens per second on a dataset with short inputs, while vLLM lags behind.

## Llama-70B on 8 x A100 (bf16)
In the offline benchmark below, both TensorRT-LLM and SGLang can scale to a high throughput.

## Llama-70B on 8 x H100 (fp8)
Now, let us test the FP8 performance. Both vLLM and SGLang use FP8 kernels from CUTLASS.

![](https://www.lmsys.org/images/blog/sglang_llama3/70b_fp8_throughput.svg)

## Llama-405B on 8 x H100 (fp8)
Finally, we benchmarked the performance on the largest 405B model. We are working with the NVIDIA team to correctly benchmark the performance of TensorRT-LLM on this model.

![](https://www.lmsys.org/images/blog/sglang_llama3/405b_fp8_throughput.svg)

## Appendix A: Detailed Benchmark Setups
Since the TensorRT-LLM latest image r24.06 does not support fbgemm_fp8 quantization in the official [meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-FP8](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-FP8) checkpoint, we use per-layer fp8 quantization in all frameworks and quantize all layers except lm_head.
